subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — follow-up & next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about FinLytics' roadmap and how you're planning to scale model-backed features across the product. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned before the sizing call: 

- Primary use cases: conversational assistant for customer support (RLHF-style dialogue) and vector search + reranking for analytics queries.
- Expected production targets (from today): ~1.2–1.8M requests/day, average sustained QPS ~20, daily peaks expected during reporting windows.
- Latency SLOs you mentioned: ~p95 <200ms for generative responses, <50ms for embeddings/rerank.
- Data/privacy: customer data is sensitive; you're interested in Private or Dedicated options for isolation and audit logs.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) so our solutions engineer can walk through throughput/latency requirements, model variants, and a preliminary sizing + cost estimate. Proposed times (all PT):
  \u2022 Tue 10/27 10:00
  \u2022 Wed 10/28 14:00
  \u2022 Thu 10/29 09:00

If one of those works, I'll send a calendar invite and loop in our SE (Camila) and solution architect to prep a short agenda. Also, can you confirm the following ahead of the call if available:
  1) List of model architectures you plan to use (or model families).
  2) Typical request size (avg tokens in/out) for the assistant flows.
  3) Any regulatory/network constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlists, egress rules).

Happy to be flexible on times if those don't fit.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0187
Book time: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/marissa

Attachment: capacity_primer.pdf (application/pdf) — high-level sizing primer (attached for context).

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — follow-up & next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that looks right. Tue 10/27 10:00 PT works for us. I'll have Priya (platform) join as well; she's cc'd.

A few preliminary numbers to help Camila prepare:
- Estimated daily requests: ~1.5M (could range 1.2–1.8M)
- Average sustained QPS: ~20
- Typical peak QPS: ~300–400 for short windows (15–30 min) during scheduled reports
- Models: a smaller conversational model we tuned (approx 7B-ish family) for chat, and an embeddings model (off-the-shelf) for nearest-neighbor retrieval.
- Average tokens: prompt ~120 tokens, completion ~60 tokens for the assistant flows.
- Latency targets: p95 <200ms gen, <50ms embedding retrieval.

We don't have final network architecture diagrams yet but can pull relevant details before the call. Looking forward to the sizing recommendations and a rough cost estimate.

Thanks,
Alex Jenkins
Head of ML Engineering, FinLytics
alex.jenkins@finlytics.com | +1 (415) 444-1212

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Tue 10/27 10:00 PT (invite includes a brief agenda). I've looped in Camila (SE) and attached a short primer that outlines the inputs we'd use for initial sizing.

Camila — can you prepare a baseline sizing and a couple of capacity options (cost/latency tradeoffs) for:
  - Option A: single dedicated pool optimized for p95 latency (lower latency, higher cost)
  - Option B: mixed routing with cached KV/prefix optimizations for cost savings (higher throughput, moderate latency)

Alex/Priya — if you can share sample traffic distribution (hour-by-hour) and a short list of representative prompts, that will help speed the analysis. If there are any specific compliance questions (SOC2 evidence, encryption-at-rest keys), flag them and we can have our security contact join.

Attachment: capacity_primer.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — see you on Tue,
Marissa

Hi Alex / Priya — quick note ahead of Tue's call with a proposed 30–40 minute technical agenda so we can leave time for Q&A:

Agenda:
1) 10m — Traffic profile & model characteristics (Alex/Priya)
2) 15m — Baseline sizing (Camila) — expected GPU counts, memory estimates, and KV/cache considerations
3) 10m — Deployment options: Dedicated vs Private and routing/fallback strategy
4) 5m — Next steps & actions (rollout timeline, PoC vs production)

Prep items that would help us deliver a solid baseline during the call:
- Hourly request distribution (CSV or sample)
- Representative prompts and average token sizes
- Any constraints on egress/VPC peering, or whitelisted IPs
- If using auth tokens or per-tenant isolation requirements — brief note on tenancy model

I'll prepare two sizing slides and a short runbook outline. Attached is the one-pager primer Marissa mentioned.

Looking forward — Camila
